items.headline: High Wind Warning issued September 25 at 2:35PM AKDT until September 25 at 9:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 45 to 60 mph with gusts up to 75 mph expected.

* WHERE...Atka and Adak.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Very strong westerly winds, due to a deep low
pressure system in the southern Bering Sea, will persist. Gusts of
60 to 70 mph are expected tonight into Saturday morning, with winds
coming down by late Saturday morning.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of widespread
power outages. Use caution if you must drive.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 25 at 12:49PM AKDT until September 27 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds could blow around unsecured objects. Travel
could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may decrease slightly Saturday afternoon
and evening before increasing briefly overnight into early Sunday.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 25 at 12:49PM AKDT until September 27 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 50 mph with gusts up to 65 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds could blow around unsecured objects. Travel
could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may peak around 70 mph Saturday morning
into early afternoon.

items.instruction:

items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued September 25 at 11:25AM AKDT until September 26 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels on average of 0.6 to 1.6 feet above the
normal highest tide line. Southeast winds becoming south winds
25 to 35 mph with gusts to 40 mph.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast including Kwigillingok and
Kipnuk.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Coastal flooding of low lying areas and erosion are
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Significant moderate-to-major flood impacts
are no longer expected. Minor flood impacts remain expected for

items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
A coastal flood warning means that flooding is occurring or
imminent. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.
